summary: Comprehensive testing of Trading Tracker & Market Analysis App completed. All 8 tabs functional, backend APIs working, frontend UI responsive, and core trading features operational.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Returns 500 error due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1

passed_tests: Dashboard page loads with all 4 stat cards (Balance, Net P/L, Win Rate, Total Trades)
Dashboard charts render (Account Balance, Pair Breakdown, Monthly Gains/Losses)
Dashboard filters work (Account, Strategy, Pair dropdowns, date range)
Trade Log Visual Journal view shows 24 trade cards with pair names, strategies, win/loss badges
Trade Log Table view works with sortable columns and 24 trade rows
Trade Log search and filter functionality works
Add Trade modal opens from both sidebar and header buttons
Add Trade modal submits correctly via POST /api/trades
Trade detail modal opens on card click and shows all trade details
Strategy Report shows 3 strategy cards with metrics and equity curves
Account Report shows per-account stats and equity curves
Market Analysis page Fetch Market Data button works (GET /api/market-data)
Market Analysis sub-tabs work (Prices, Indicators, Signals, Macro)
Asset Detail page loads (asset selector needs market data)
Calendar page with month and week view toggle works
Calendar shows trades on correct dates with win/loss indicators
Calculators page with all 4 calculators (Position Size, Risk/Reward, Pip Value, Compound Growth)
Sidebar navigation between all 8 tabs works perfectly
Sidebar collapse/expand toggle works
Theme toggle works (dark/light mode)
CSV export button works on Trade Log
Backend API: GET /api/trades returns 28 seeded trades
Backend API: POST /api/trades creates new trades successfully
Backend API: DELETE /api/trades/{id} removes trades successfully
Backend API: GET /api/market-data returns live market data via yfinance
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in settings endpoint by ensuring proper JSON serialization
